posts.title: Finishing Up My Appalachian Trail Hike
posts.description: The Priest Mountain Shelter, VA (37.817850, -79.070375) Seven years ago I hiked half the Appalachian Trail, from its midpoint in Harper’s Ferry, WV, to its northern terminus at Katahdin, ME. This year I finished the remaining half of the trail, from Springer Mountain, GA, back to Harper’s Ferry, WV.

posts.title: My year in photos (2025)
posts.description: Chilly snowy winter scene seen from Mono Lake Vista Point (California, February 2025) 2025 was a crazy year for the world, but since we already know that, I’m not going to focus on that here. The thing I have most control over is my own life and living it the best and fullest way I can.
